en.title: Maximum Total Efficiency with Given Batch Sizes
en.description:
Assign every server exactly once to batches of the given sizes; the efficiency of a batch is its maximum capacity − its minimum capacity, and a single-element batch has efficiency 0. Find the maximum total efficiency. This definition and the rule that each element is used exactly once were recovered from the original HTML.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n k, the second line contains n capacity values, and the third line contains k numServers values. 1≤n≤200000, 1≤k≤n, capacities are in 1..10⁹, and every group size is ≥1, with the sizes summing to n.
en.output: Output the maximum total efficiency, using a 64-bit integer.
hints: Let q be the number of groups of size at least 2; use the q largest capacities overall as the group maxima and the q smallest as the group minima, and fill the remaining slots with the other elements.
